crop.description: Crop in percent (0-100). 1 value = symmetric, 2 values = vertical,horizontal, 4 values = left,top,right,bottom. Excel reads but does not write crops — overrides shared base which marks add/set true (pptx-only writability).

title.description: OOXML @title attribute on cNvPr (distinct from alt).

decorative.description: Mark the picture as decorative (a16:decorative ext under cNvPr). Excludes it from screen-reader alt-text traversal.
decorative.readback: true when the picture carries the a16:decorative flag

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees (positive = clockwise). Stored OOXML-internal as 60000ths of a degree on Transform2D @rot.

opacity.description: Picture opacity. Accepts percent (50, '50%') or fraction (0.5). 100 / 100% / 1.0 = fully opaque.
opacity.readback: integer percent (0..99); key omitted when fully opaque

hyperlink.description: Picture-level hyperlink. External URL (https://...) or in-document jump (#SheetName!A1).

anchor.description: Cell-range anchor (e.g. 'B2:E6') or anchorMode token ('oneCell'/'twoCell'/'absolute'). Cell-range form implies twoCell mode.

anchorMode.description: Explicit anchor mode: 'oneCell' / 'twoCell' / 'absolute'. Overrides any anchor= mode token.

shadow.description: Outer shadow effect. 'none' to clear, or a color/spec accepted by DrawingEffectsHelper.

softEdge.description: Soft edge effect radius. 'none' to clear.

crop.l.description: Crop from left edge as a percentage (e.g. 10 = 10%, '10%' also accepted). Internally stored in 1/1000 percent units.

crop.r.description: Crop from right edge as a percentage.

crop.t.description: Crop from top edge as a percentage.

crop.b.description: Crop from bottom edge as a percentage.

srcRect.description: Compound crop spec, e.g. 'l=10,r=10,t=5,b=5'. Equivalent to crop.l/crop.r/crop.t/crop.b.

anchoredTo.description: anchor descriptor — sheet/cell-range path the picture is anchored to.

mergeAnchor.description: true when the picture is anchored to a merged-cell region.

x.description: x as TwoCellAnchor column/row index (xlsx cell-anchor positioning, integer).

y.description: y as TwoCellAnchor column/row index (xlsx cell-anchor positioning, integer).

width.description: width — TwoCellAnchor column/row span (xlsx cell-anchor positioning, integer)

height.description: height — TwoCellAnchor column/row span (xlsx cell-anchor positioning, integer)

cropBottom.description: Crop from bottom edge as percent (0-100). Aliases: cropbottom.

cropLeft.description: Crop from left as fraction (<=1) or percent (>1). E.g. cropLeft=0.1 or cropLeft=10 both mean 10%.

cropRight.description: Crop from right edge as percent (0-100). Aliases: cropright.

cropTop.description: Crop from top edge as percent (0-100). Aliases: croptop.

name.description: Override the auto-generated 'Picture {id}' label on cNvPr @name.

fallback.description: optional PNG fallback for SVG sources. When omitted, a 1x1 transparent PNG is generated.

alt.description: alternative text (DocProperties.Description). When omitted, no description is written (intentional: an auto-filled filename is worse than none for screen readers). Aliases: alttext, description.

contentType.description: OOXML content-type of the embedded image part (e.g. `image/png`, `image/jpeg`). Read from the package part referenced by the BlipFill embed relationship.
contentType.readback: MIME-style content-type string from the image part

fileSize.description: embedded image file size in bytes (length of the image part stream).
fileSize.readback: byte length of the embedded image part

relId.description: relationship id of the embedded image part (rId-style token). Required input for `get --save <path>` binary extraction.

src.description: image source (file path, URL, data-URI); accepted on add/set only. Get does NOT surface this key; the embedded relationship id is exposed under a separate Format["relId"] key.
src.readback: add/set-only input; not echoed by Get. Use Format["relId"] to inspect the embedded image relationship.

note: Aliases: image, img. Anchor via ParseAnchorBoundsEmu — accepts cell counts or unit-qualified lengths. SVG sources get a PNG fallback.
